venezuela-dual-drafts-2019.venezuela-dual-drafts-2019/public/compon: Draft US-VOTE [1] failed with nine votes for, three against, and three abstentions [2] because China and Russia opposed it [3], while Draft RU-VOTE [4] failed with four votes for, seven against, and four abstentions [5] due to insufficient support [6]. The US approach favored international-observed elections and unhindered aid [7], whereas the Russian draft promoted the Montevideo Mechanism dialogue and government-led assistance [8]. Neither draft conferred authority. Analytical Suggestion: Reconcile electoral legitimacy with inclusive dialogue mechanisms.
venezuela-dual-drafts-2019.venezuela-dual-drafts-2019/CHAIR/compone: CHAIR Ndong Mba of Equatorial Guinea announced the results as Council President, with his delegation abstaining on S/2019/186 and voting for S/2019/190.
venezuela-dual-drafts-2019.venezuela-dual-drafts-2019/INDONESIA/com: Indonesia abstained on both drafts, urged inclusive dialogue, and asked all parties to accept the Secretary-General's good offices [INDONESIA].
